description: This is a shell script (`start-backend.sh`) designed to start a backend server for a project. It checks for the presence of PHP or Node.js to run the backend; if neither is available, it falls back to simple HTTP placeholders or keeps the process alive. It involves environment setup, server launching, and fallback mechanisms. The script is specifically tailored for the 'Book-store-221706' project, managing a PHP router script and defining behavior for different runtime environments.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs timestamped messages with a specific prefix `[start-backend]`.

methods.name: fatal
methods.description: Outputs a fatal error message and exits the script with a non-zero status.
